title: 第7章 失了分寸第8章 胸有惊雷面若平湖
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
等沈云离开后，明老收回了视线，疑惑道：“方先生对他有兴趣？”
白衣青年懒洋洋道：“只是觉得有趣罢了，或许他能给我点惊喜。”
明老双眼混浊，此时却是精光闪动，‘能让方先生看中，这小子究竟有何过人之处。
直到今日，明老也不知道方先生的来历，他只记得自己被对方救下后，就被安排到了眼前的藏经阁。
如今一百多年过去，方先生和当时没有半分变化，而他已经白发苍苍，行将朽木了。
回到家中，沈云开始回忆刚才发生的一幕。
“听说明老已经镇守藏经阁超过一百载了，能让他如此重视的会是何方神圣。”
沈云心中思索，随后拿出了黑色玉简，立刻就感受不同。
普通的玉简白璧无瑕，玉石光泽，这枚黑色玉简却光芒不显，重量更是普通玉简的三倍，尽显不凡之处。
“不知道里面有什么内容。”
沈云不再迟疑，心神沉入玉简之中。
顿时感觉头脑一沉，庞大的信息流席卷而来，化作一篇字字珠玑的道文。
“五行之精，天地之本。
五行运转，万物生辉。
五行之水，润泽万物。
五行之土，坚若磐石....”
沈云挠了挠头，道文挥挥洒洒，好像囊括了天地至理，然而都是一些玄之又玄的骈文，如同天书一般，晦涩难懂。
等他再次探查玉简，只能听到飘渺的声音，如同远方传来的呓语。
看起来像是精心的恶作剧，任谁来了都会一头雾水，然而沈云却满脸认真，超凡的悟性让他捕捉到了一些零星的东西。
接下来的日子，沈云足不出户，正巧沈平生出门办事了，他就一人在家沉心修炼。

昨天他突破了炼气五层，放眼沈家年轻一代也是佼佼者，许多三四十岁的修士也不过这个层次。
他的心情很平静，全身心沉浸在玉简的道文中。
“五行循环生生不息，蕴藏天地枯荣，当真玄妙。”
沈云心中感慨，道文阐述了五行相生相克的至理，让他受益匪浅。
试着将火木灵气融为一炉，原本泾渭分明的两色光芒渐渐连在了一起，却是一触即分，再次化为原状。
在这短暂的接触中，沈云精神高度集中，突然出现奇妙的变化。
咚！
仿佛大钟敲响，精神仿佛迎来了洗礼，无形无质的精神力汇聚成涓涓细流，在脑海深处打开了另一扇门户。
“这是神念！”
沈云双眼神采奕奕，却见神念流水在门户中汇聚，最后变成了一条金色的河流。
霎时间，他的气息发生了翻天覆地的变化，就像生命层次得到了跃升，愈发的深邃而奥妙。
“想不到竟然修炼出了神念，开辟了识海，真是无心插柳柳成荫。”
沈云发出了感叹声，这段时间他修炼了很多功法，精神力逐渐壮大，没想到这次参悟量变化作质变，一举凝聚出了神念。
虽然五行相融失败了，不过沈云也看出了些许端倪，黑色玉简记载了一门五行融合的绝世道法。
“我这也算看懂了吧，过两天就去拜访方先生。”
沈云不再继续死磕，这门道法博大精深，绝非一朝一夕可以参悟，他决定先去见方先生一面。
...
闲来无事，沈云再次炼制起符篆，立刻感受到了不同。
content_en:
After Chen Yun left, Mr. Ming withdrew his gaze and asked doubtfully: "Mr. Fang is interested in him?"
The young man in white said lazily: "I just think it's interesting. Maybe he can give me a surprise."
Ming Lao's eyes were cloudy, but at this moment they were flashing with light, "What is so special about this boy that Mr. Fang can take notice of."
To this day, Mr. Ming doesn't know Mr. Fang's origins. He only remembers that after he was rescued by the other party, he was placed in the Sutra Pavilion in front of him.
Now more than a hundred years have passed, Mr. Fang has not changed at all from what he was then, and he is already gray-haired and dying.
Back home, Shen Yun began to recall the scene that had just happened.
"I heard that Mr. Ming has been guarding the Sutra Pavilion for more than a hundred years. Who can make him pay so much attention to it?"
Chen Yun thought in his mind, then took out the black jade slip, and immediately felt different.
Ordinary jade slips are white and flawless, with jade luster, but this black jade slip has no luster, and its weight is three times that of ordinary jade slips, showing its extraordinary qualities.
"I don't know what's in it."
Chen Yun no longer hesitated, and his mind sank into the jade slip.
Suddenly, I felt my head sink, and a huge flow of information swept over me, turning into a word-for-word prose.
“The essence of the five elements is the foundation of heaven and earth.
When the five elements move, everything will shine.
The water of the five elements moistens all things.
The soil of the Five Elements is as solid as a rock..."
Chen Yun scratched his head, and the Taoist texts were flowing and flowing, as if they contained the most important principles of heaven and earth. However, they were all mysterious and mysterious parallel prose, like a book from heaven, obscure and difficult to understand.
When he explored the jade slip again, he could only hear vague sounds, like murmurs coming from afar.
It looked like an elaborate prank, and anyone who came would be confused. However, Shen Yun had a serious face, and his extraordinary understanding allowed him to capture some scattered things.
In the days that followed, Shen Yun stayed at home. It happened that Shen Pingsheng went out to do errands, so he stayed at home and practiced cultivation alone.
Yesterday he broke through the fifth level of Qi refining. Looking at the younger generation of the Shen family, they are also outstanding. Many monks in their thirties and forties are not at this level.
His mood was very calm, and he was immersed in the Taoist text of the jade slip.
"The cycle of the five elements is endless, containing the prosperity and prosperity of heaven and earth. It is truly mysterious."
Shen Yun sighed in his heart, Daowen expounded the principle of the mutual interdependence of the five elements, which benefited him a lot.
Trying to merge the fire and wood spiritual energy into one furnace, the two distinct colors of light gradually connected together, but they separated at the touch of a finger and returned to their original state again.
During this brief contact, Shen Yun was highly concentrated, and a strange change suddenly occurred.
Boom!
It was as if a big bell was ringing, and the spirit seemed to be baptized. The invisible and immaterial spiritual power gathered into a trickle, opening another door deep in the mind.
"This is divine thought!"
Chen Yun's eyes were filled with excitement, but he saw the water of spiritual thoughts gathering in the portal, and finally turned into a golden river.
In an instant, his aura underwent earth-shaking changes, as if the level of his life had jumped up, becoming more profound and mysterious.
"Unexpectedly, I have cultivated spiritual thoughts and opened up the sea of consciousness. It is really unintentional."
Chen Yun sighed. During this period of time, he practiced a lot of techniques and his mental power gradually grew stronger. Unexpectedly, the amount of insight changed this time and he condensed his spiritual thoughts in one fell swoop.
Although the fusion of the five elements failed, Shen Yun also saw some clues. The black jade slip recorded a peerless Taoist method of fusion of the five elements.
"I understand now. I will visit Mr. Fang in two days."
Chen Yun no longer continued to fight. This Taoist method was profound and profound and could not be understood overnight. He decided to go see Mr. Fang first.
...
With nothing to do, Chen Yun refined the talisman seal again and immediately felt the difference.
